cloze.sentence: Urban residents rely heavily on public transport; ____, people in rural areas often depend on private cars.
The older generation valued job security. ____, many young workers today prioritise flexibility and personal growth.
Some countries invest heavily in renewable energy. ____, others continue to rely on cheap fossil fuels.
Wealthy nations can afford advanced healthcare; ____, developing countries frequently struggle to fund basic clinics.
My sister loves crowded festivals. ____, I prefer a quiet evening at home with a book.
The first study found a strong link between diet and health. The second, ____, reported no clear connection.
Private schools tend to have small classes; ____, state schools often teach thirty students at once.
In the north the summers are short and cool. ____, the southern regions enjoy long, hot seasons.
Cats are usually independent animals. Dogs, ____, thrive on constant human companionship.
Last year's economy grew steadily. This year, ____, growth has almost completely stalled.

translate.source: Các thành phố lớn rất ồn ào; trái lại, vùng nông thôn thường yên tĩnh và thanh bình.
Anh trai tôi thích thể thao mạo hiểm, ngược lại tôi lại thích những hoạt động nhẹ nhàng.
Một số người ủng hộ học trực tuyến; trái lại, nhiều người vẫn tin vào lớp học truyền thống.
Nền kinh tế năm ngoái phát triển tốt; ngược lại, năm nay lại gặp nhiều khó khăn.
Người giàu có nhiều lựa chọn về giáo dục; trái lại, người nghèo có rất ít cơ hội.
Traditional shops are closing down; in contrast, online stores are expanding rapidly.
He speaks four languages fluently. His brother, in contrast, struggles even with English.
In contrast to last decade, most families now own at least one smartphone.
The government cut spending on the arts. In contrast, it increased the military budget.
Northern cities suffer from harsh winters; in contrast, the coast stays mild all year.

scenario: In an IELTS Task 2 essay comparing city and country life, write one formal sentence using 'in contrast'.
You are writing an academic report comparing two survey results. Use 'in contrast' formally to highlight the difference.
In a class presentation comparing two products, say one neutral sentence using 'in contrast'.
Write a polite email to a colleague comparing this quarter's sales with last quarter's, using 'in contrast'.
In a casual chat with a friend about your different music tastes, use 'in contrast' lightly.
You are writing a paragraph for a geography assignment comparing two climates. Use 'in contrast' academically.
In a debate summary, compare your team's view with the opposing team's using 'in contrast' formally.
Write a caption for a comparison chart in a business slide, using 'in contrast' concisely.
In a reflective journal entry, compare your past self with your present self using 'in contrast'.
In a formal essay on education, contrast public and private schooling with a sentence using 'in contrast'.

cloze.sentence: Some people prefer to save every spare coin, ____ others spend money as soon as they earn it.
____ the older buildings were made of stone, the newer ones are built almost entirely from glass.
My brother enjoys team sports, ____ I would rather run alone in the early morning.
The first candidate had years of experience, ____ the second offered fresh, creative ideas.
In some cultures, meals are eaten quickly, ____ in others dining can last for hours.
Cities offer countless job opportunities, ____ rural areas often provide a slower, healthier lifestyle.
____ men once dominated the workforce, women now hold nearly half of all professional jobs.
The novel focuses on emotion, ____ the film emphasises action and spectacle.
Some students learn best by listening, ____ others need to write everything down.
Solar power is clean but expensive, ____ coal is cheap but heavily polluting.

translate.source: Anh ấy thích làm việc một mình, trong khi tôi lại làm việc nhóm hiệu quả hơn.
Người dân thành thị đi lại bằng tàu điện, trong khi người dân nông thôn chủ yếu dùng xe máy.
Một số học sinh giỏi môn Toán, trong khi những em khác lại xuất sắc ở môn Văn.
Điện thoại thông minh rất tiện lợi, trong khi chúng cũng khiến chúng ta xao nhãng.
Bố tôi thích đọc báo giấy, trong khi mẹ tôi chỉ đọc tin tức trên mạng.
The north of the country is industrial, whereas the south is mainly agricultural.
She remained calm during the crisis, whereas everyone else began to panic.
Online courses are flexible, whereas classroom lessons offer more direct interaction.
Whereas the first plan was risky, the second was safe but slow.
Older workers value stability, whereas younger ones often chase new challenges.

scenario: In a formal IELTS essay contrasting two lifestyles, write one sentence using 'whereas'.
Write an academic sentence for a report contrasting two age groups' habits, using 'whereas'.
In a comparison paragraph for a history assignment, use 'whereas' to link two eras formally.
You explain to a classmate how you and your friend study differently. Use 'whereas' in a casual sentence.
In a business memo comparing two suppliers, write one professional sentence using 'whereas'.
Write a sentence for an essay contrasting the advantages of two energy sources, using 'whereas'.
In a job interview, contrast your current role with your desired one using 'whereas' politely.
In a product review comparing two phones, write a balanced sentence using 'whereas'.
In a formal debate, contrast your position with your opponent's using 'whereas'.
In a travel blog contrasting two cities you visited, write one descriptive sentence using 'whereas'.

cloze.sentence: The factory ignored safety rules; ____, several workers were seriously injured.
He failed to submit the assignment on time and ____ lost twenty percent of his marks.
Prices rose sharply last month, and ____ many families cut back on spending.
The team practised hard all season; ____, they won the championship with ease.
The city banned private cars in the centre, and ____ air quality improved dramatically.
She skipped breakfast every day and ____ struggled to concentrate in her morning classes.
Demand for the product collapsed; ____, the company was forced to close two factories.
The river was heavily polluted, and ____ the local fishing industry disappeared.
Interest rates were cut, and ____ more people began to take out loans.
He invested without any research; ____, he lost most of his savings.

translate.source: Anh ấy làm việc quá sức, do đó sức khỏe của anh ấy ngày càng giảm sút.
Chính phủ tăng thuế, kết quả là giá hàng hóa tăng lên đáng kể.
Công ty không đổi mới, do đó họ dần mất khách hàng vào tay đối thủ.
Cô ấy ôn tập rất chăm chỉ, kết quả là cô ấy đạt điểm cao nhất lớp.
Rừng bị chặt phá nghiêm trọng, do đó nhiều loài động vật mất môi trường sống.
The new law was poorly explained; consequently, few citizens actually followed it.
Sales dropped every month, and consequently the shop went out of business.
He ate too much junk food and consequently gained a lot of weight.
The bridge was closed for repairs; consequently, traffic doubled on the other routes.
The students were not warned about the test and consequently performed badly.

scenario: In an IELTS essay on pollution, write one formal sentence using 'consequently' to link a cause and its effect.
Write an academic sentence for an economics report explaining a result, using 'consequently'.
In a science lab report, describe the outcome of an experiment using 'consequently' formally.
You explain to your boss why a deadline was missed. Write one professional sentence using 'consequently'.
In a news-style paragraph about a policy change, write a formal sentence using 'consequently'.
In a cause-and-effect essay about screen time, use 'consequently' to state a result.
Write a sentence for a history essay explaining a consequence of a war, using 'consequently'.
In a formal complaint email, explain the effect of a delay using 'consequently'.
In a health article, describe the result of poor sleep using 'consequently'.
In a business case study, explain a company's downfall using 'consequently'.

cloze.sentence: The evidence is incomplete; we should ____ be cautious about drawing firm conclusions.
Public transport reduces traffic and pollution, and governments should ____ invest more in it.
The two figures are almost identical, and it is ____ safe to treat them as equal.
Children learn languages quickly; schools should ____ start foreign-language lessons early.
The medicine has serious side effects and is ____ not recommended for young children.
Fossil fuels are running out; we must ____ develop renewable sources of energy.
The bridge is unsafe and will ____ remain closed until further notice.
Reading widely improves vocabulary; students are ____ encouraged to read for pleasure.
The costs clearly exceed the benefits, and the project should ____ be cancelled.
She has the most experience and is ____ the strongest candidate for the position.

translate.source: Bằng chứng còn yếu, vì vậy chúng ta không nên vội đưa ra kết luận.
Ô nhiễm không khí ngày càng nghiêm trọng, do đó chính phủ cần hành động ngay.
Trẻ em học rất nhanh, vì vậy nên bắt đầu dạy ngoại ngữ từ sớm.
Chi phí quá cao, do đó dự án nên được xem xét lại.
Cô ấy có nhiều kinh nghiệm nhất, vì vậy cô ấy là ứng viên phù hợp nhất.
The results are unclear; we should therefore repeat the experiment.
Smoking damages the lungs and should therefore be strongly discouraged.
The demand is very high; the company should therefore increase production.
He broke the rules and must therefore accept the consequences.
The plan is too risky and will therefore not be approved.

scenario: In an IELTS Task 2 conclusion, write one formal sentence using 'therefore' to draw a logical conclusion.
Write an academic sentence in a research report that uses 'therefore' to state an inference.
In a formal recommendation section of a report, use 'therefore' to justify an action.
You advise your manager on a decision. Write one professional sentence using 'therefore'.
In a philosophy essay, use 'therefore' to connect a premise to a conclusion formally.
In a persuasive essay on climate change, use 'therefore' to argue for urgent action.
Write a sentence for a legal-style document using 'therefore' to state a consequence.
In a maths or logic explanation, use 'therefore' to reach a result.
In a formal proposal, use 'therefore' to recommend approving a budget.
In an argumentative paragraph about exams, use 'therefore' to conclude your point.

cloze.sentence: The company invested in new technology, and ____ its productivity rose sharply.
Heavy rain fell for three days; ____, several roads were completely flooded.
She practised every day, and ____ her English improved remarkably.
The government reduced taxes, and ____ people had more money to spend.
The factory was fined for pollution; ____, it installed cleaner equipment.
Many young people move to the cities, and ____ villages are slowly emptying.
He ignored the doctor's advice, and ____ his condition grew worse.
The bank collapsed, and ____ thousands of customers lost their savings.
Fuel prices doubled overnight; ____, transport costs soared across the country.
The team communicated poorly, and ____ the whole project was delayed.

translate.source: Trời mưa lớn suốt đêm, kết quả là nhiều con đường bị ngập nặng.
Công ty cắt giảm chi phí, kết quả là chất lượng sản phẩm giảm sút.
Cô ấy học chăm chỉ, kết quả là cô ấy đỗ kỳ thi một cách dễ dàng.
Giá xăng tăng cao, kết quả là chi phí vận chuyển cũng tăng theo.
Nhiều nhà máy xả thải ra sông, kết quả là nguồn nước bị ô nhiễm nghiêm trọng.
The new policy was unpopular, and as a result the minister resigned.
The crops failed this year, and as a result food prices increased sharply.
He trained for months, and as a result he finished the marathon easily.
The bridge was damaged; as a result, drivers had to take a long detour.
The company expanded too fast, and as a result it ran into serious debt.

scenario: In an IELTS essay about deforestation, write one formal sentence using 'as a result'.
Write an academic sentence for an economics report explaining an effect, using 'as a result'.
In a science report, describe what happened after an experiment using 'as a result'.
You explain to your team the effect of a decision. Write one professional sentence using 'as a result'.
In a news article about a storm, describe the aftermath using 'as a result'.
In a cause-and-effect paragraph about pollution, use 'as a result' to show the outcome.
Write a sentence for a history essay about a revolution using 'as a result'.
In a personal statement, describe how effort led to success using 'as a result'.
In a formal report on traffic, explain the effect of a new law using 'as a result'.
In a health blog, describe the effect of exercise using 'as a result'.

cloze.sentence: Many everyday habits harm the environment; ____, leaving lights on wastes a great deal of energy.
Technology has changed how we communicate. Video calls, ____, let families stay in touch across the world.
Some subjects are highly practical; cookery, ____, teaches skills students use for life.
There are many ways to stay healthy. You could, ____, walk to work instead of driving.
Small changes can save money. Cooking at home, ____, is far cheaper than eating out.
Governments can encourage recycling; ____, they might charge a fee for plastic bags.
Exercise has many benefits. It reduces stress, ____, and improves sleep quality.
Some jobs are becoming automated. Cashiers, ____, are gradually being replaced by machines.
Learning a language opens doors. It can, ____, improve your job prospects abroad.
Cities face serious problems; traffic congestion, ____, wastes hours of people's time each day.

translate.source: Có nhiều cách để tiết kiệm năng lượng; ví dụ, chúng ta có thể tắt các thiết bị khi không dùng.
Công nghệ mang lại nhiều lợi ích, ví dụ như giúp học sinh học từ xa dễ dàng hơn.
Một số môn học rất thực tế, ví dụ, tin học giúp ích rất nhiều cho công việc.
Nhiều thói quen nhỏ gây hại cho sức khỏe, ví dụ như thức khuya thường xuyên.
Chính phủ có thể khuyến khích giao thông công cộng, ví dụ bằng cách giảm giá vé xe buýt.
Some animals are in danger; the tiger, for instance, is now extremely rare.
There are many renewable sources of energy, solar power, for instance.
Big cities offer great opportunities; for instance, they have many well-paid jobs.
Reading has real benefits; for instance, it helps you build a wider vocabulary.
Some hobbies are expensive; skiing, for instance, requires costly equipment and travel.

scenario: In an IELTS essay, support a general claim about technology with a specific example using 'for instance'.
Write an academic sentence that introduces an example in a report, using 'for instance'.
In a class presentation, give an example to illustrate a point using 'for instance'.
You explain a work process to a new colleague and give an example using 'for instance'.
In a formal essay on the environment, illustrate a problem with an example using 'for instance'.
In a persuasive paragraph about healthy living, give a concrete example using 'for instance'.
Write a sentence for a tutorial that offers a practical example using 'for instance'.
In a discussion about job automation, give an example using 'for instance'.
In an educational blog, illustrate a study tip with an example using 'for instance'.
In a formal report on city problems, give a specific example using 'for instance'.

cloze.sentence: ____ the heavy rain, the outdoor concert went ahead as planned.
She passed the exam with a high score ____ having very little time to prepare.
____ its high cost, the new policy has failed to reduce unemployment.
The team lost the final ____ playing brilliantly for most of the match.
____ all the warnings, many people still ignore the dangers of smoking.
He remained calm and polite ____ the customer's rude behaviour.
____ years of research, scientists have not yet found a cure for the disease.
The company continued to grow ____ the difficult economic conditions.
She kept smiling ____ feeling exhausted after the long journey.
____ its small size, the phone has an incredibly powerful battery.

translate.source: Mặc dù trời mưa to, họ vẫn quyết định đi bộ đường dài.
Mặc dù có ít thời gian, cô ấy vẫn hoàn thành bài luận rất tốt.
Mặc dù chi phí cao, chính sách này vẫn được nhiều người ủng hộ.
Mặc dù đã cố gắng hết sức, đội của chúng tôi vẫn thua trận.
Mặc dù còn trẻ, anh ấy đã đạt được rất nhiều thành tựu.
Despite the traffic, we arrived at the airport on time.
Despite earning a good salary, he never seems to save any money.
The plan went ahead despite strong opposition from local residents.
Despite her fear of flying, she travelled around the world alone.
Despite the many advantages of technology, some problems remain unsolved.

scenario: In an IELTS essay, concede a point about technology's problems using 'despite' in a formal sentence.
Write an academic sentence acknowledging a limitation in a report, using 'despite'.
In a formal reflection, describe an achievement made under difficult conditions using 'despite'.
You praise a teammate's effort in a professional message using 'despite'.
In a persuasive essay, admit a drawback but hold your position using 'despite'.
Write a sentence for a news report about an event held in bad weather using 'despite'.
In a job application, highlight success achieved against obstacles using 'despite'.
In a book or film review, praise a work despite a flaw using 'despite'.
In a formal complaint, note that a problem persisted despite earlier promises using 'despite'.
In a motivational speech, encourage others to continue despite hardship using 'despite'.

cloze.sentence: Governments impose heavy taxes on tobacco ____ discourage people from smoking.
She woke up at five every morning ____ have enough time to study.
The company lowered its prices ____ attract more customers.
Many students study abroad ____ improve their career prospects.
We must reduce carbon emissions ____ protect the planet for future generations.
He took a second job ____ pay off his student loans more quickly.
The city built more cycle lanes ____ encourage people to leave their cars at home.
You should read the instructions carefully ____ avoid making silly mistakes.
The charity organised the event ____ raise money for the local hospital.
Schools introduced stricter rules ____ create a calmer learning environment.

translate.source: Chính phủ tăng thuế thuốc lá để giảm số người hút thuốc.
Cô ấy dậy sớm mỗi ngày để có thêm thời gian ôn tập.
Nhiều người học ngoại ngữ để có cơ hội việc làm tốt hơn.
Chúng ta cần bảo vệ rừng để giữ gìn môi trường sống của động vật.
Công ty giảm giá sản phẩm để thu hút thêm khách hàng.
He saved money for years in order to buy his first house.
The government built new roads in order to reduce traffic in the city centre.
Students take practice tests in order to prepare for the real exam.
The factory installed filters in order to cut down on air pollution.
She spoke slowly in order to make sure everyone understood her.

scenario: In an IELTS essay on the environment, state the purpose of a policy using 'in order to' formally.
Write an academic sentence explaining the aim of a study, using 'in order to'.
In a formal proposal, explain the goal of a project using 'in order to'.
You explain to your manager why you took a certain action, using 'in order to'.
In a persuasive essay, justify an action by its purpose using 'in order to'.
Write a sentence for a set of instructions explaining a step's purpose using 'in order to'.
In a personal statement, explain why you did something using 'in order to'.
In a report on public health, explain the aim of a campaign using 'in order to'.
In a business plan, state a strategy's objective using 'in order to'.
In a formal letter, explain the reason for a request using 'in order to'.

cloze.sentence: ____, while technology brings clear benefits, its risks must not be ignored.
____, I firmly believe that the advantages of studying abroad outweigh the disadvantages.
____, governments and individuals must work together to solve this pressing issue.
____, both sides of the argument have merit, but urgent action is clearly needed.
____, education remains the most powerful tool for reducing inequality.
____, although online learning is convenient, it cannot fully replace the classroom.
____, the evidence strongly suggests that prevention is better than cure.
____, protecting the environment should be a top priority for every nation.
____, I would argue that the benefits of exercise far outweigh the effort involved.
____, a balanced approach is the most sensible way to tackle this problem.

translate.source: Tóm lại, tôi tin rằng lợi ích của việc học ngoại ngữ vượt xa những khó khăn.
Kết luận lại, cả chính phủ và người dân đều cần chung tay giải quyết vấn đề này.
Tóm lại, mặc dù công nghệ rất tiện lợi, chúng ta vẫn nên sử dụng nó một cách hợp lý.
Kết luận lại, giáo dục là chìa khóa để giảm bớt bất bình đẳng trong xã hội.
Tóm lại, bảo vệ môi trường nên là ưu tiên hàng đầu của mỗi quốc gia.
In conclusion, the benefits of public transport clearly outweigh its drawbacks.
In conclusion, I strongly support the idea that reading should be encouraged from an early age.
In conclusion, both governments and citizens share responsibility for tackling climate change.
In conclusion, while there are some risks, the advantages are simply too great to ignore.
In conclusion, a healthy lifestyle depends on both good food and regular exercise.

scenario: In an IELTS Task 2 essay, write the opening sentence of your final paragraph using 'in conclusion'.
Write the closing line of an academic report summarising your findings, using 'in conclusion'.
In a formal debate, deliver your closing statement using 'in conclusion'.
In a class presentation, wrap up your talk with a sentence using 'in conclusion'.
Write the final sentence of a persuasive essay on health using 'in conclusion'.
In a formal proposal, summarise your recommendation using 'in conclusion'.
In an argumentative essay on education, restate your position using 'in conclusion'.
In a research summary, state your overall finding using 'in conclusion'.
In a speech at the end of a project, sum up the outcome using 'in conclusion'.
In an essay on the environment, close with a call to action using 'in conclusion'.

cloze.sentence: ____, both the government and citizens must act quickly to reduce waste.
____, the advantages of remote work clearly outweigh its few drawbacks.
____, a healthy diet and regular exercise are the keys to a long life.
____, while the plan has some risks, it is well worth pursuing.
____, education is the most effective way to break the cycle of poverty.
____, I believe cities should invest far more in public transport.
____, technology has transformed our lives in both positive and negative ways.
____, the report shows that customer satisfaction has improved this year.
____, protecting wildlife requires cooperation between many different countries.
____, there are strong arguments on both sides, but change is clearly necessary.

translate.source: Tóm lại, cả xã hội cần chung tay để giảm thiểu rác thải nhựa.
Tóm lại, làm việc từ xa mang lại nhiều lợi ích hơn là bất lợi.
Tóm lại, một chế độ ăn lành mạnh và tập thể dục đều đặn rất quan trọng.
Tóm lại, các thành phố nên đầu tư nhiều hơn vào giao thông công cộng.
Tóm lại, giáo dục là cách hiệu quả nhất để thay đổi cuộc sống của con người.
To sum up, the survey shows that most people prefer flexible working hours.
To sum up, there are clear benefits to learning a second language early.
To sum up, we must all take responsibility for protecting the environment.
To sum up, the project was a success despite a few small problems.
To sum up, both diet and exercise play a vital role in good health.

scenario: At the end of a class presentation, wrap up your main points using 'to sum up'.
In a spoken summary during a meeting, briefly conclude using 'to sum up'.
Write the closing sentence of an informal essay using 'to sum up'.
In a short speech, summarise your argument for the audience using 'to sum up'.
In a project debrief with colleagues, sum up the results using 'to sum up'.
In a discussion post on a forum, conclude your opinion using 'to sum up'.
In a study-group review, summarise a chapter for your friends using 'to sum up'.
In a video script, close a tutorial with a recap using 'to sum up'.
In an argumentative paragraph, restate your view briefly using 'to sum up'.
In a casual explanation to a friend, wrap up your main point using 'to sum up'.

cloze.sentence: The new policy is designed to ____ the growing problem of youth unemployment.
Governments must ____ climate change before it becomes impossible to reverse.
The report fails to ____ the root causes of poverty in the region.
Schools need to ____ bullying more seriously if they want students to feel safe.
It is essential to ____ these safety concerns before the factory reopens.
The committee met to ____ the issue of rising traffic in the city centre.
We cannot ignore these challenges; we must ____ them directly and quickly.
The manager promised to ____ the staff's complaints about long working hours.
Any successful solution must ____ both the economic and social sides of the problem.
The essay clearly ____ the question of whether tourism harms local cultures.

translate.source: Chính phủ cần giải quyết vấn đề thất nghiệp ở giới trẻ.
Chúng ta phải đối phó với biến đổi khí hậu trước khi quá muộn.
Nhà trường cần giải quyết tình trạng bắt nạt một cách nghiêm túc hơn.
Bản báo cáo không đề cập đến nguyên nhân gốc rễ của vấn đề.
Cần phải giải quyết những lo ngại về an toàn trước khi nhà máy mở cửa lại.
The government has promised to address the housing shortage within five years.
We need a plan that addresses both the causes and the effects of the crisis.
The new law aims to address inequality in the education system.
The teacher took time to address every student's concerns before the exam.
Companies must address their impact on the environment more responsibly.

scenario: In an IELTS essay, argue that a government must tackle a social problem, using 'address' formally.
Write an academic sentence about how a study tackles a research question, using 'address'.
In a formal report, state that a plan deals with a specific issue, using 'address'.
You promise a client that your team will deal with their complaint, using 'address' professionally.
In a policy proposal, explain how the policy tackles a problem, using 'address'.
In a persuasive essay on education, argue that schools must tackle an issue, using 'address'.
Write a sentence for a meeting agenda about dealing with a concern, using 'address'.
In a formal email to staff, promise to deal with their concerns, using 'address'.
In an environmental essay, argue that leaders must tackle pollution, using 'address'.
In a job interview, describe how you handled a difficult problem, using 'address'.

cloze.sentence: In my opinion, the benefits of studying abroad clearly ____ the drawbacks.
The long-term advantages of exercise far ____ the short-term discomfort.
For many families, the costs of private school ____ any possible benefits.
The risks of the new drug seem to ____ its limited advantages.
Supporters argue that the gains from tourism ____ the environmental damage it causes.
The convenience of online shopping does not always ____ the pleasure of visiting real shops.
In this case, the disadvantages of the plan clearly ____ its benefits.
The rewards of learning a language ____ the effort it takes to master it.
Whether the pros ____ the cons depends largely on your personal situation.
The advantages of renewable energy ____ its higher initial costs.

translate.source: Theo tôi, lợi ích của việc học đại học vượt trội hơn so với chi phí bỏ ra.

translate.source: Có thể cho rằng internet là phát minh quan trọng nhất của thế kỷ hai mươi.

translate.source: Ở một mức độ nào đó, tôi đồng ý với ý kiến này, nhưng vẫn còn nhiều điều cần bàn.
